needs.proposedSignature: a face declaration escalate?: AbilityCost + a covers[].by kind 'escalate' with the anchored shape /^escalate(?:[-] ?| )(.+?)\.?$/, and a choose-mode form { count: { min: 1, max: 'modes' } } (or count: 'one-or-more') for "Choose one or more -"
needs.semantics: Escalate is an additional cost paid once per mode chosen beyond the first, which only means anything once choose-mode can express a variable number of modes. Today choose-mode.count is a fixed number, so the parser's own draft records "Choose one or more -" as count: 1 - a silently wrong verdict on a line it claims, not just a missing declaration.
